# AgentVigil

> A mobile task board + email alert layer for AI agents, aggregating agent tasks across every harness into one board and one inbox.

## Overview

AgentVigil is a standalone Node.js bridge service (NOT a plugin). It aggregates agent tasks from multiple harnesses running on the same computer into one board and one inbox. It serves a mobile PWA task board and pushes alerts/digests over email. It does not create tasks and does not orchestrate agents — it observes them and calls the human back (email + mobile) when attention is needed.

- Entry: `bridge.js` (`npm install && node bridge.js`, default `0.0.0.0:8787`)
- Runtime: Node.js >= 18, dependencies: express, ws, nodemailer, qrcode
- Multi-harness since V4 (plugin-style adapters, implemented): each harness gets an adapter under `lib/adapters/` registered in `lib/adapters/index.js`; board/email pipeline is harness-agnostic by design
- Built-in harnesses: 爱思办公 (Agnes Office, ACP via local backend `agnesd`, can send messages), WorkBuddy (local transcript JSONL read + process gating; headless CLI messaging since V4.1), Trae (memory-subsystem transcript read, read-only, 2-state)

## Key concepts

- **Harness / channel**: any tool that runs AI agent tasks. Each enabled channel contributes tasks to the board, tabs, alerts and the merged digest email. Adding a new one = implement `lib/adapters/base.js` + register in `lib/adapters/index.js`.
- **Pairing**: QR code shows LAN/public URL + 6-digit pairing code; code exchanges for a device token (`X-Device-Token` header). Pairing code lives in memory only (TTL 5–120 min, reusable within TTL); bridge restart invalidates device tokens; new codes are auto-emailed.
- **Task states (alert engine, `lib/alerts.js`)**: exactly four, judged from the latest interaction round only:
  - `running` 正在执行 — activity within 90s or running steps exist
  - `ended` 执行完成 — last tool call succeeded, or last AI reply is plain-text conclusion
  - `failed` 异常 — latest result errored (last tool call failed / tool stream tail failed)
  - `waiting` 待确认 — latest message is from the user with no AI reply since (conversation blocked)
  - Blocking set = `failed` + `waiting`. Blocking alert fires immediately per watched task; no repeat bombing within the same blocking episode; state resets on recovery. Detection cadence: fixed 60s. Watchlist is a `{channel, taskId}` pair list — source of truth is the phone's localStorage, mirrored into `config.json` `alerts.watchlist`. Trae summaries have no status field → 2-state simplification, no instant alerts but included in digests.
  - Naming mapping (do not mix): the unified task format (`lib/adapters/base.js`, `task.status` consumed by UI / API / adapters) uses `done` for the completed state; `ended` is only the alert engine's internal key (`lib/alerts.js` STATE_LABEL) for the same semantic. `task.status` must always be one of `running | done | failed | waiting` (judgment priority: running > failed > waiting > done) — never write `ended` into a task's status.
- **Digest (V4 merged)**: every `alerts.digestIntervalMinutes` (10–240, default 60), watched tasks across all enabled channels are compiled into ONE email, sectioned per channel (channel → task catalog → task). Channel alert switches live in `channels.<ch>.{alertEnabled,digestEnabled,alertPrefix}`; interval/title and board list limit are global.
- **Tunnel**: Cloudflare quick tunnel (auto-download cloudflared) or named tunnel (fixed domain, idempotent init: reuses tunnel, fixes CNAME, writes Public Hostname route). Falls back to LAN-only on failure.
- **Read-only iron rule**: on agnesd only `initialize` / `session/list` / `session/load` are called; WorkBuddy/Trae adapters only read local transcript files. Write exceptions are mobile messaging — agnes `session/prompt` and WorkBuddy headless CLI continuation (V4.1) — gated by paired device token + rate limit (10/min) + config kill switch. Trae has no injection channel: `sendMessage` throws UNSUPPORTED (501).

## Architecture

```
lib/adapters/ - V4 channel adapters (base.js interface + agnes.js / workbuddy.js / trae.js + index.js registry factory with warm snapshots, stale-while-revalidate)
lib/channels.js - single source of truth for channel alert strategy (per-channel config, agnes fallback to legacy top-level alerts, watchlist pair normalization)
lib/acp.js    - agnesd ACP client (auto-discover port + read secret from process memory via lib/get-agnes-secret.ps1)
lib/official.js - agnes session list -> conversation-round aggregation (wrapped by adapters/agnes.js)
bridge.js     - static hosting of web/ PWA, adapter assembly, channel enable/disable hot-apply
             - lib/localApi.js   GET /health (channels summary), /api/tasks?channel=, /api/tasks/:id?channel=, POST /api/tasks/:id/messages
             - lib/setupApi.js   /api/setup/* (tabbed config center, 127.0.0.1 only, remote = 403)
             - lib/remoteApi.js  mobile remote config (email-token auth: recipient / sender profiles / test mail / alert & digest switches / tunnel mode)
             - lib/wsHub.js      /ws WebSocket push (task_update / step_update), token check + heartbeat (realtime events wired for agnes)
             - lib/pair.js       QR pairing (code -> device token)
             - lib/tunnel.js     Cloudflare tunnel lifecycle
             - lib/mailer.js     SMTP push (HTML email with inline QR); lib/smtp.js low-level client
             - lib/alerts.js     V3 watchlist + blocking alerts; V4 merged digest (sendDigestAll)
             - lib/wecom.js      optional WeCom (企业微信) push
web/         - PWA: index.html (channel tabs + connect/list/detail + message input), setup.html (6-tab config center), remote.html, sw.js shell cache
tests/       - offline verify scripts (config migration / merged digest / trae adapter; temp-dir sandbox, never touch real config.json)
```

- Real-time: WebSocket event-driven + 8s fallback polling; exponential backoff reconnect; no re-render on unchanged content. Non-agnes channels refresh via snapshots / pull-to-refresh.
- No demo data: a channel whose harness is not running shows an empty board (process gating for WorkBuddy/Trae); three-place warning (console log / push email / mobile banner), auto-recovers when the app starts.

## Configuration (config.json, gitignored — never commit)

`listenHost/port`, `acp.*` (autoDiscover/port/secret), `timeoutMs`, `pollIntervalMs`, `tunnel.*` (enabled/cloudflaredPath/mode/hostname/tunnelToken), `pair.codeTtlMinutes`, `messages.enabled`, `mailer.*` (smtp host/port/user/pass/to, saved sender profiles with >=2 failover, toHistory), `wecom.*`, `setup.done`, `alerts.*` (watchlist pairs/digestIntervalMinutes/digestTitle + legacy agnes fallbacks digestEnabled/alertEnabled/alertPrefix), `board.*` (listLimit/listLimitMax, V4.1 global), `channels.<ch>.{enabled,alertEnabled,digestEnabled,alertPrefix}` (agnes/workbuddy/trae). Old config.json auto-migrates on load; unknown channel keys are preserved.

Secrets (SMTP auth codes, tunnel tokens) live only in local `config.json` and `敏感配置备份.md` — both gitignored, never send to frontend, never commit.
